title: Dog Video Fest HK 2026 (Cat & Dog)
synopsis:
The first-ever Dog Video Fest is making its debut at Broadway Cinematheque! Stop scrolling dog reels on your tiny phone, we are bringing the best compilation of Hong Kong’s most adorable dogs to the big screen. Dog lovers, be prepared for these canines running straight to your hearts!

 

Part of the proceeds will be donated to local animal charity LAP to support their animal rescue mission.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
有貓貓短片又點可以無狗狗短片！全新「本地狗狗短片」正式登陸電影中心！唔駛再隔住手機熒幕睇片，直接將全香港最有活力最治癒的狗狗影片搬上大銀幕。入場的愛狗之人，準備好迎接狗狗撲面而來的瘋狂活力啦！

 

部分收益將捐贈給本地動物慈善機構LAP用予動物救援。
